espressif-esp32s3-korvo2-v3-rndis.implementation_scope: Korvo2 V3 RNDIS source candidate with independent assistant_korvo_rndis identity; reuses the existing ST7789 280x240 display, checked expander RMW, ADC1CH4 keys, ES8311/ES7210 TDM4 MIC1 24kHz and software PCM AEC. USB OTG GPIO19/20 host uses iot_usbh_rndis=0.3.1, CDC and IOT_ETH esp_netif DHCP, key XY_RNDIS. SDK5.5 root_port_unpowered gates early enumeration: install host and event worker, CDC skip host init, install RNDIS and netif/glue, register immutable handle state, start ETH, then enable root port. ETH callbacks filter by handle; GOT_IP and LOST_IP use ip_event_got_ip_t and filter by netif. Disconnect invalidates the address; replug waits for a new DHCP event. Persistent match-list and callback/driver state are retained after partial failure; reboot required to retry. No NVS erasure and no synchronous indefinite network wait; main retains its 60second wait. device_network selects WiFi or RNDIS; RNDIS configuration requires a ws/wss URL only and preserves existing SSID/password. WiFi AP remains the local configuration transport. UART0 console replaces USB console to avoid the shared PHY. Existing WebSocket/HTTP pairing, DNS, reconnect and OTA remain in the common path. Module must already expose a working RNDIS DHCP uplink: no AT dial, SIM or APN manager. Target preflight exit1: missing iot_usbh_rndis0.3.1, no stage or compilation. Camera, ILI9341 option, touch, SD, battery/charge/sleep and original MUTE/PLAY/SET features are not implemented. No target or physical acceptance.
